analysis.purpose: The PHP extractor: turns one PHP file into symbol nodes (function, class, interface, trait, method) with member-of edges and intra-file call edges, using a vendored grammar so it stays offline.
responsibilities: Emit a symbol per declaration with qualifiedName, span and signature
Emit member-of edges to the enclosing symbol or file
Emit calls edges only where the callee resolves in the same file

businessRules.rule: Cross-file resolution is the resolver phase job; this extractor never guesses across files.
businessRules.rationale: Capability honesty — a guess here is indistinguishable from a fact downstream.

nodes.name: PHP extraction
nodes.summary: Symbols, nesting and intra-file calls for PHP.
